tools.name: create_key
tools.description: Create a scoring key (no signup). One key covers all agents, identified by OTel service.name. webhook_url (https) is optional but recommended: it receives an HMAC-signed POST when any agent's score changes band.

tools.name: get_scores
tools.description: Current drift score per agent under the key: 0-39 deviating, 40-69 watch, 70-100 normal; status 'learning' until the baseline freezes (30 runs over at least 3 days). 'feedback' lists alerts to ask your human about (share answer_url, never answer it yourself).

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: Add or change the https webhook. It is POSTed on every band change and rebaseline, HMAC-SHA256-signed with the scoring key (header x-kyde-signature: sha256=<hex> over the raw body).

tools.name: claim_key
tools.description: Attach your human's email to the key (double opt-in: Kyde mails a confirmation link). Once confirmed, the key is claimed: the human gets the management dashboard, and rebaseline, webhook changes and revocation work only for them — no agent, including you, can reset its own score. tools.name: rebaseline
tools.description: Forget one agent's learned baseline and score and relearn from its next 30 runs over at least 3 days. tools.name: verify_agent
tools.description: Prove who is on the other end before delegating work: challenges the Shine ID at shine.kyde.com, waits for the agent to confirm over its own authenticated connection, then verifies the Ed25519-signed statement against Shine's JWKS and compares the nonce hash. tools.name: revoke_key
tools.description: Revoke the key and permanently delete all data stored under it. Requires confirm=true.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "claim_key" stacks urgency/override words (never, mandatory). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
